expect_text: If the user already authorized a scoped action, continue within that scope without asking them to choose again.
Ask only when a consequential choice or missing authorization blocks the next action.
Codex permission requests stay in plain chat.
If scope or authority is still unknown, stop after the concise question and do not perform downstream effects.
When custom-agent runtime is available **and** `.codex/agents/browser-verifier.toml` exists, dispatch the pass to that custom agent.
Missing custom-agent runtime or artifact is an inline fallback, **not** `MISSING-TOOL`.
The session — use it for real, capture as you go
reject_text: When `request_user_input` is callable, use that structured chooser. Otherwise ask one concise direct question in chat with the same applicable choices, then end the turn immediately.
Execute nothing downstream until the user makes an explicit choice.
